test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Discovered'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in blank number 3 is option 1:** "discovered".**
 
• In this context,** "discovered"** means to find or identify something for the first time.
 
• It is the** correct term** to use when referring to the first time a new species, such as the Bosavi woolly rat, is found and recognized by scientists.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'According to the Integrated Taxonomic Information System (ITIS) there are more than 60 species of rat, which means they come in all sizes. They are typically 5 inches (12 centimeters), or longer, according to Encyclopedia Britannica. The largest species is the Bosavi woolly rat, which was **discovered** in 2009 in the rainforest of Papua New Guinea (and doesn't have a scientific name yet). It is (4)_____ the size of a cat - 32.2 inches (82 cm) from nose to tail and (5)______ around 3.3 lbs. (1.5 kilograms), according to CNN.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options don't fit as well in this context:
 
 
• **"Invented" -** This term is used when something new has been designed or created, usually referring to human-made objects or ideas, not living organisms.
 
• **"Denuded" - **This term means to strip something of its covering or adornments. It does not fit in the context of finding a new species.
 
• **"Screened" -** This term means to examine or investigate something thoroughly. While scientists certainly do examine new species, the term does not fit in the context of first finding a new species.
